name: skills
description: Generic skills, agents and mods for Claude Code

plugins.name: builder
plugins.description: Watches the pull request an /implement session is working on, shows its state and its agents, and wakes the session when the pull request changes

plugins.name: foreman
plugins.description: Runs a parent session's /implement sub sessions: shows them in a band above the prompt and a pane, nudges an idle one, notifies the person when one needs them, frees a slot when one finishes, and wakes the parent's model with one line when there is a decision to make
